overnight_incidents.description: Complainant Smt. Meera Sharma reported break-in at her residence. Entry gained through rear window. Gold jewellery worth approx. Rs. 4,50,000 and Rs. 35,000 cash stolen. Neighbours reported seeing two unknown males fleeing on a black motorcycle around 01:30 hrs.

Victim Sri. Arjun Reddy (28) assaulted by group of 3 persons following altercation outside a restaurant. Victim sustained head injuries and was shifted to St. John's Hospital. Condition stable. CCTV footage being obtained from nearby establishments.

overnight_incidents.location: Koramangala Inner Ring Road, near Sony Signal
overnight_incidents.description: Two-wheeler (KA-01-MN-5523) collided with BMTC bus (KA-01-F-1287) at signal junction. Rider Sri. Manoj Kumar (32) sustained fractures to left leg. Breath analyser test positive — BAC 0.12%. Case registered under MV Act and IPC 279.

Complainant Smt. Lakshmi Devi (55) reported gold chain (approx. 15 grams) snatched by pillion rider on a red Honda Activa while she was walking near SBI ATM. Vehicle had no registration plate visible. Direction of flight: towards Madiwala.

active_cases.remarks: Key witness statement recorded. Stolen property worth Rs. 12 lakhs recovered from Yelahanka hideout. 3 of 5 accused in judicial custody.

active_cases.status: Technical analysis of phone records pending
active_cases.remarks: 12 complainants identified — total loss Rs. 8,45,000. SIM cards traced to Jharkhand. Coordination with Ranchi Cyber Cell initiated.
Protection order issued by Magistrate. Complainant relocated to Sandhya Women's Shelter. Accused warned — any violation to result in immediate arrest.
250 grams of MDMA seized from EGL Tech Park area. Accused fled before raid. Passport impounded. Airport and railway station alerts issued. Possible links to Goa supply chain under investigation.
Honda City (KA-05-MR-2217) stolen from apartment parking in 5th Block. Pattern matches 3 similar thefts in HSR Layout — possible linked series.
Forged property documents used to obtain bank loan of Rs. 1.2 crore. Bank alerted. Accused property in Whitefield under attachment proceedings.

repeat_offenders.name: Ravi Kumar alias 'Blade' Ravi
repeat_offenders.address: Ejipura Cross, Near Tata Nagar, Bengaluru
repeat_offenders.remarks: Currently in judicial custody (CR-389/2026). Known associate of inter-district theft gang. History of bail jumping — oppose bail strongly.

repeat_offenders.name: Mohammed Irfan alias 'Techie'
repeat_offenders.remarks: Released on bail (CR-267/2025) on 2026-06-20. Bail condition: weekly reporting. Last report: 2026-07-04. Missed this week's reporting — verify compliance.

repeat_offenders.name: Nagesh S. alias 'Auto' Nagesh
repeat_offenders.remarks: MO matches last night's chain snatching incident (FIR 145/2026) — operates with pillion rider on two-wheeler. Verify alibi urgently. Rowdy sheet active.

alerts.message: Hon'ble Home Minister convoy scheduled to pass through Hosur Road and Inner Ring Road between 10:00–12:00 hrs. Route clearance and security deployment required. Coordination with SPG and Traffic Police mandatory.

IMD has issued Orange Alert for Bengaluru Urban district. Heavy rainfall (64–115 mm) expected between 14:00–22:00 hrs. Flood-prone areas: Koramangala valley, Madiwala lake surroundings. Deploy disaster response teams on standby.

Protest march by BBMP contract workers planned from Town Hall to Vidhana Soudha via MG Road between 11:00–15:00 hrs. Estimated gathering: 2,000–3,000 persons. Traffic diversions to be implemented. Anti-riot platoon on standby.
